title: Switching location reloads the page with the same terms and counts
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You are enrolled at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, is the default and is held by 2 customers.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-21 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Write down every row's name, Customers count and Vendors count, and which row has the Default tag.
  2. Switch location to {Location-B} with the location switcher at the top right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Term-A} shows the Default tag and 2 customers.
  • Step 2: the page reloads and shows exactly the same rows in the same order, with the same Customers and Vendors counts and the Default tag still on {Term-A}. The terms and the default belong to the whole organization, not to a location.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R16: “The page is organization-wide. Switching location while on the page reloads it with the same terms, counts and default.”
  • Key Decisions: “One default and one term list per organization, shared by customers and vendors.”
  • Out of Scope: “Per-location or per-work-type default terms. 2 insights. One default per organization.”
